body: As I step closer to observe, my heart races. The engine’s idle sound echoes ominously in the quiet evening air. A sense of protection wells up inside me—protecting these strangers from harm. But fear gnaws at the edges of my mind, urging me to move further away. Stay beside them and keep them steady, I whisper to myself. Put real distance between myself and it, another voice insists. Both urges pull at my soul, testing its limits.
